# Skill slots

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build_plugin_skills.py from architect_framework/data/skill-slots.yml -->

Every skill the framework can route to. A slot whose content is not installed is
**empty**: say which pack fills it and for how much, point to the store, and give
the install command. Never write an empty skill's content yourself.

- Store: https://www.agensi.io/creators/ledesixsixsix
- Check one skill: `python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/architect_runtime.py" --bootstrap skills offer <skill-id>`
- Install a bought zip: `python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/architect_runtime.py" --bootstrap skills install <zip>`
- What a workspace still needs: `python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/architect_runtime.py" --bootstrap skills status <workspace>`
